steps.content: When Eliza enters, everything in the dressing room appears normal. Phanuel is still seated before the mirror, dutifully rehearsing her answers for the upcoming interview. And yet, something in the air has quietly shifted.
Eliza stands behind Phanuel, eyes fixed on her back. One second. Two seconds...
Using the busy backstage crew as cover, you've managed to slip out through a side entrance.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I need to cause a little commotion. Can you buy me some time?

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Here at the TV station? You are aware that this is the center of the city's busiest part, right? Things could get out of hand.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's exactly what I need. A huge crowd.
Shortly after you've left, the variety show begins filming as scheduled. Eliza seems a little agitated, hovering by the monitor the whole time.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Come say hello to our audience!

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Hi everyone! I'm Phanuel. Very happy to be here today!
Through the monitor, Phanuel's smile looks the same as ever. But Eliza knows. Something Phanuel has been holding down with all her might has just been pried loose.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Do you... like balloons? They wear colorful little outfits, and they float up so, so high, and then... BANG!!!
